name: ANS Communications
summary: Sydney ISP since 1996; still trading as a web-hosting/domain business (ANS COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD, ACN 072 793 858).

events.details: Dialup then ADSL, now web hosting; 'Since 1996' per ans.com.au branding. ANS COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD (ACN 072 793 858) still active per ABR (ABN from 1 Nov 1999).

Continues as ANS Communications Pty Ltd, an ecommerce web hosting/domain registration provider ('Most Trusted Ecommerce Hosting Provider Since 1996', ans.com.au). Prior 'death c.2005' record was fabricated boilerplate and has been removed.
